impact: Broad AI de-risking hits MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, GOOGL and MSFT into Nvidia's print; a strong Nvidia report could spark a relief bounce, a miss would deepen the selloff.
summary: Wall Street closed sharply lower Monday for a third straight loss. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.49% to 24,509.76, the S&P 500 dropped 1.92% to 7,416.59 and the Dow lost 739 points (1.41%) to 51,608.17. Nvidia fell about 4% ahead of its results Tuesday after close (consensus EPS $2.40 on $108.7B revenue), and the chip index was down about 5% intraday.
title: Nasdaq closes down 2.5%, S&P down 1.9% as Nvidia leads AI rout
